prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. PRODUCTION REFERENCE SHEET, landscape, not a finished book page. Bold clean clear 2D children's cartoon throughout, crisp continuous dark outlines, flat clean colors, restrained smooth cel shading, no painted or grainy texture, no gouache, no embossed relief, no 3D. Original friendly readable illustration. Ordinary neutral settings; no flags, religious/political symbols or costumes. No logos, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, captions, watermarks or page borders. Natural anatomy and coherent hand/prop contact. Essential content at least 8 percent inside every edge.
WD-KIT / Kit: six-year-old human boy, golden light-medium skin, short straight black side-parted hair, teal T-shirt, mustard shorts, navy sneakers. The ONLY named human protagonist is Kit. Zoe MUST NOT appear. Ignore every other child shown in reference sheets; unnamed adults may appear only when this scene explicitly requires them. Preserve exact reference identity and clothing.
Book: The Hopping Boot; World Discovery; fiction.
Setting: World Discovery fantasy playroom in afternoon light; pale floor and green rug. Kit wears his usual navy sneakers. One loose red dress-up boot is the only enchanted object.
Design locks for the book's recurring subjects/props (NOT a visibility list; never insert later objects/states prematurely): One loose red enchanted boot with one gold dot, small enough to stand completely inside the box; One brown box with a removable lid; its rim is low enough for the boot’s established hop, and the inside is tall enough to close over the upright boot
 Create a clean separated reference board on white: show the principal recurring props/animals in front, side and three-quarter views, their relative scale beside any named human cast, and a single simple location key showing the persistent setting and daylight/palette. The human character model sheet is a supporting identity reference, not content to copy wholesale. Show only the subjects this book requires. Use initial object states: Only the loose boot moves; navy sneakers stay worn.. For orientation, the opening location/action is: World Discovery fantasy playroom in afternoon light; pale floor and green rug. Kit wears his usual navy sneakers. One loose red dress-up boot is the only enchanted object. Kit claps as the loose dotted red boot lifts in one short hop. Exact state: Only the loose boot moves; navy sneakers stay worn.. Do not show a completed craft or later scene merely because the finished object is listed in design locks. No future story events, no captions.
REFERENCE DESIGN CONSTRAINTS: Only Kit, never Zoe. One loose RED child dress-up boot with EXACTLY ONE large round GOLD DOT on outer ankle, NO face/eyes/arms/wings; no otherboot or shoe besides Kit's navy sneakers which remain worn. Scale lock: boot upright12cm tall, brown lidded box interior15cm tall35cm long25cmwide; boot fullyfitsinside evenstanding. Show box initiallyEMPTY, lidseparate, bootoutside. Boxwallsflatintactnolabels; low enough for established18cm hop. Location simple pale woodenfloor and one green ovalrug windowleft, lowshelfright. No magical motion on reference or boot on Kit's foot.

visualReview.note: Directly viewed Kit-only playroom model, one red boot with one gold dot and no face/limbs, open brown box/removable lid. Box interior taller than upright boot, low rim allows established short hop. Final pages corrected toe direction.
visualReview.limits: Direct agent image and sequence inspection; no classroom or physical-device observation.
